name: Cloudflare
description: A connectivity cloud platform offering security, performance and developer services.
longDescription: Cloudflare offers services spanning content delivery, application security, DNS and developer infrastructure. Product availability and pricing vary by service.
benefits: Multiple services have free entry options

articleContent.introduction: Cloudflare provides internet infrastructure and security services.
articleContent.overview: Its product portfolio covers website performance, DNS, security and developer tooling.
articleContent.howItWorks: Customers configure the relevant Cloudflare service for their domains, applications or development workflows.
articleContent.evaluation: Identify the specific Cloudflare product you need and compare its limits and pricing with alternatives.

faqs.a: Some Cloudflare products have free plans. Check each product's current terms.
